Table 4 gives mean BDI-II change −10.41 (SD 11.08) with sumac fruit powder and −9.74 (SD 8.50) with placebo, between-group p=.78. Both groups followed calorie restriction. The trial does not establish clinical equivalence or estimate Parkinson-specific depression.

Official update posted November 25, 2026. Still recruiting and reports no results. The descriptive summary mentions motor accuracy as multitasking context. The structured outcomes list cognitive task performance, mood, anxiety, fatigue, sleep and physiologic outcomes, with no separate bradykinesia or motor-accuracy endpoint.
The original describes lycopene mechanistic context and has no raw watermelon effect estimate.
